create_model_longcat_flash: create a LongcatFlashForCausalLM model with LongcatFlashConfig and optional quant_config for inference
build_decoder_layer: build a LongcatFlashDecoderLayer with config, layer_id, quant_config, and optional alt_stream for transformer blocks
run_forward_inference: run forward pass of LongcatFlashForCausalLM with input_ids, positions, and forward_batch to generate logits
load_model_weights: load model weights from checkpoint into LongcatFlashForCausalLM with support for async loading and expert params mapping
test_moe_expert_routing: test LongcatFlashMoE forward pass with router, top-k selection, and expert computation for mixture-of-experts layers
